outcome: Number of IUD insertions and removals
Number of premature rupture of membranes (PROM) cases
Number of intrauterine fetal death (IUFD) cases
cohort: This study analyzed data from pregnant women at a single hospital between January 2017 and December 2021.
finding: Compared to the preceding three years, the COVID-19 pandemic was associated with a decrease in the number of outpatient visits, emergency outpatient visits, IUD removals, and total deliveries.
